title: Missing fisherman, 7-year-old son found stranded off Biliran town

blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — A fisherman and his seven-year-old son who went missing after leaving for a fishing trip were found stranded in the maritime area near Maripipi, Biliran province, on Monday, according to the Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO) of Kawayan. In a report, the Kawayan MDRRMO said its personnel, in coordination with the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) in Kawayan, conducted a search-and-rescue operation after the two failed to return home from their fishing trip. The father and son, originally from Barangay Balite in Kawayan and reportedly residing at St. Rafael Village Pabahay in Barangay Kansanok, left […]...
